paid.headline: Turn agent knowledge into a team operating surface.

capabilities.label: Team Mode Management
capabilities.paid_value: Workspace ownership, comparison, history, archive workflows, and team policies.

capabilities.label: Advanced PR Impact Graph and GitHub App

capabilities.label: Repair Ownership
capabilities.paid_value: Owners, SLA, comments, history, linked PRs/issues, and team dashboards for knowledge debt.

capabilities.label: Policy Packs
capabilities.paid_value: Commercial governance rules, approvals, policy exceptions, checks, and audit exports.

capabilities.label: Memory Governance and Provider Fleet Status

capabilities.label: Workflow and Stack Packs
capabilities.paid_value: Stack-specific governance for Next.js SaaS, Python FastAPI, Node monorepos, Supabase, AI agent runtime, GitHub PR review, agency onboarding, release governance, and migrations.

capabilities.label: Audit Export
capabilities.paid_value: Signed audit bundles, approval trails, policy exceptions, incident replay, and governance exports.

capabilities.label: History and Alerts
capabilities.paid_value: Retained PR impact history, repair ownership history, alerts, and anomaly reporting.

capabilities.label: SSO/RBAC/Audit and Hosted/Private/VPC
capabilities.paid_value: Enterprise auth, retention, deployment, support, compliance controls, custom integrations, and private or sovereign deployment.

capabilities.label: Commercial Pack Registry
capabilities.paid_value: Private pack registry, pack metadata, provenance, rollout controls, and partner packs.

usage_billing_policy.initial_policy: Do not start with complex per-run or per-token Inspector billing.
prefer: simple seat and workspace pricing in the paid commercial config
fair limits on repositories, retained history, and PR events
custom enterprise terms for high-volume usage
future_options: PR impact events over configured limits

add_on_streams.label: Workflow / Stack Packs
examples: migration from n8n, Dify, CrewAI, or LangGraph

offer: setup call for early design partners
success_criteria: at least one policy pack used
team lead can explain before/after review value

rules: paid source/components have clear commercial license headers
NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES are maintained when needed
paid backend does not silently relicense open-core contributions
external_connector_rules: treat external memory as optional connector, not source of truth
show component name, source URL, version, and license before install
require explicit Enable or Install action
preserve license and NOTICE obligations when redistributing or bundling
include connector status in reports and metrics
never allow external memory to override code, tests, evidence, or decisions
warn in team mode when memory is shared across worktrees or cannot be isolated
provide disable/uninstall and audit view in paid implementation

anti_patterns: building a Dify or n8n clone
